A named, versioned workload with suggested SLOs. Files live in schema/presets/&lt;name&gt;.v&lt;version&gt;.yaml. The workload block is immutable once released (a change is a new version), so a preset name always means one request mix; slos and rps\_hint are suggestions outside the workload hash and may be corrected in place.

Schema file: `schema/json/workload-preset.schema.json`. Generated from servtuner commit `5b46cdad0e5c`.

## Top level

| Field         | Type                                                                 | Required | Description                                                                                            |
| ------------- | -------------------------------------------------------------------- | -------- | ------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------ |
| `name`        | `string`                                                             | Yes      | Lower-case words joined by hyphens; the file name starts with it. pattern `^[a-z][a-z0-9-]*$`          |
| `version`     | `integer`                                                            | Yes      | ≥ 1                                                                                                    |
| `description` | `string`                                                             | Yes      |                                                                                                        |
| `engines`     | array of [engineType](/reference/runspec/#enginetype)                | Yes      | The engines that can run this workload. bench rejects the preset on any other. at least 1 item         |
| `workload`    | [presetWorkload](/reference/schemas/workload-preset/#presetworkload) | Yes      |                                                                                                        |
| `slos`        | [slos](/reference/runspec/#slos)                                     | Yes      | Suggested SLOs. The New run view copies them into the RunSpec; bench never applies them implicitly.    |
| `rps_hint`    | array of [rpsHint](/reference/schemas/workload-preset/#rpshint)      | Yes      | Hand-written starting points per GPU class for the load ladder, not measured capacity. at least 1 item |

## Definitions

### presetWorkload

The workload fields a preset fixes. streaming is the RunSpec's choice, and seed is not part of a workload's identity.

| Field          | Type                                             | Required | Description        |
| -------------- | ------------------------------------------------ | -------- | ------------------ |
| `api`          | [workloadApi](/reference/runspec/#workloadapi)   | No       | Default: `"chat"`. |
| `dataset`      | [dataset](/reference/runspec/#dataset)           | Yes      |                    |
| `conversation` | [conversation](/reference/runspec/#conversation) | No       |                    |

### rpsHint

| Field       | Type     | Required | Description                                   |
| ----------- | -------- | -------- | --------------------------------------------- |
| `gpu_class` | `string` | Yes      | A GPU class label such as a100-80gb.          |
| `start_rps` | `number` | Yes      | Offered RPS of the first ladder stage. &gt; 0 |
